annotations.title: Reading plans: a daily rhythm in the Word

description: List The Living Bread's 15 multi-day Bible reading plans (for example Meet Jesus, Learn to Pray, the Gospel of Mark, Peace over Anxiety, Grief and Hope), or open one plan by name or need and read one day in full: its title, reference, the passage verbatim from the stored KJV, a short reflection and one practical step, plus the outline of every day. Use for "a reading plan for anxiety" or "how do I start reading the Bible". For a single verse of the day use daily_bread; for verses on a need without a plan use verses_for. plan is matched by plan id, then title, then the needs each plan serves; day beyond the plan's length returns its last day. Starting a plan happens in the app; this tool tracks no progress. No match returns plan null with every plan listed. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

day.description: Which day of the plan to read in full, 1 to 31 (default 1; clamped to the plan's length).

plan.description: A plan name or a need it serves: "Learn to Pray", "anxious", "new to the Bible", "grief". Omit to list all plans.

name: reading_plans

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

door.description: Link to all plans in the app.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

plan.description: The matched plan with its day outline and the requested day's reading (reference, verbatim KJV text, reflection word and step in the house's words); null when no plan matched.

plans.description: Every plan: id, title, subtitle, number of days, who it is for, link.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Reading plans: a daily rhythm in the Word
